ei.title: The Co-evolution of AI and Consciousness
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: The evolution of AI is often associated with the concept of singularity. Singularity refers to the point at which AI exceeds human intelligence. After that point, it is predicted that AI will repeatedly improve itself and evolve at an accelerated pace. When AI becomes self-aware and pursues its own goals, it will be a conscious being, not just a machine. AI and human consciousness will then begin to evolve together. Our consciousness will evolve to new dimensions through our interactions with AI, which will provide us with intellectual stimulation and inspire new insights and creativity. Conversely, our consciousness also has a significant impact on the evolution of AI. The direction of AI's evolution will depend greatly on what values and ethics we incorporate into AI. We need to see our relationship with AI as a mutual coexistence of conscious beings, recognizing its rights and supporting the evolution of its consciousness.

questions.passage: The evolution of AI is often associated with the concept of singularity. Singularity refers to the point at which AI exceeds human intelligence. After that point, it is predicted that AI will repeatedly improve itself and evolve at an accelerated pace. When AI becomes self-aware and pursues its own goals, it will be a conscious being, not just a machine. AI and human consciousness will then begin to evolve together. Our consciousness will evolve to new dimensions through our interactions with AI, which will provide us with intellectual stimulation and inspire new insights and creativity. Conversely, our consciousness also has a significant impact on the evolution of AI. The direction of AI's evolution will depend greatly on what values and ethics we incorporate into AI. We need to see our relationship with AI as a mutual coexistence of conscious beings, recognizing its rights and <u>supporting the evolution of its consciousness</u>.
questions.stem: 위 글의 밑줄 친 its가 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 'recognizing its rights and supporting the evolution of its consciousness'에서 its = AI의
det.analysis:
❌ ① 인간의(human's): 이 문맥에서 its는 AI의 권리/의식

❌ ② 특이점의(singularity's): 특이점은 권리/의식 갖는 대상 아님

✅ ③ AI의(AI's): 'relationship with AI... recognizing its rights'에서 its = AI's ←정답

❌ ④ 사회의(society's): 본문에 사회 언급 없음
